timeline.caption: Write a script rule
timeline.subtitle: Line three calls fetch. Line one names it in a comment.

lines.text: // Orders reach the network through fetch() in src/api, never here.

timeline.caption: A prompt for Claude Code
timeline.subtitle: Claude Code gets a prompt for a script rule.

lines.text: claude -p "Add a script rule no-fetch: no file of core calls fetch(). Read the syntax tree, so a comment is not a finding."

timeline.caption: The rule reads the syntax tree
timeline.subtitle: The agent writes the rule. It reads the syntax tree of the file.

timeline.caption: The law lists the rule on core
timeline.subtitle: The law gets the rule and its reason, and core lists it.

lines.text: why: Only the api layer talks to the network.

timeline.caption: One finding
timeline.subtitle: Lawcheck try reports line three and leaves the comment.

lines.text: lawcheck: try no-fetch (script rule, enforced)  1 finding in 1 of 2 files
src/core/cart.ts:3  error[no-fetch]  calls fetch outside the api layer

timeline.subtitle: The guide has these steps as text.

timeline.caption: Write a reviewer rule
timeline.subtitle: The error says only failed. The reviewer is Claude Code, with no key.

lines.text: claude -p "Add a reviewer rule clear-errors for core: every error message a caller can see says what happened and what the caller can do next."

timeline.caption: The rule, in plain words
timeline.subtitle: The agent writes the rule and lists it on core.

lines.text: Every error message a caller can see says what happened and what the caller can do next.
src/core/refund.ts:2  error[clear-errors]  The thrown error 'failed' does not say what happened (refund of an unpaid order was rejected) or what the caller can do next.

timeline.caption: The review passes
timeline.subtitle: With a clearer message, the review passes.
